blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The University of the Philippines Los Baños (UPLB) on Sunday condemned the arrest of its students and other delegates of the Lakbayan ng Timog Katagalugan protest caravan. The group marched from the campus to Manila to protest the government’s Pax Silica initiative and the planned visit of US President Donald Trump
